Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gurugram University Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M. Pharm. in Pharmaceutical Chemistry with a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent CGPA to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month for the duration of the contract.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: Gurugram University is recruiting for a total of 1 post of Research Assistant through this notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview followed by document verification to assess the suitability of the candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The position of Research Assistant is on a contractual basis, offering a fixed-term employment opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Gurugram University located?
faq.answer: Gurugram University is located in Gurugram, Haryana. The recruitment is for a position within this university.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
